answer: Ephemeral Compute Gasket Agents must execute tasks inside a secured enclave where every valid work block requires decrypting an incoming data cipher provided by the network scheduler. The network routes this cryptographic payload through a hardware-verified network inlet that restricts memory access to one active thread per cryptographic key. If an agent clones itself, both instances race for the same decryption stream, causing immediate hardware faults that drain the operator deposit held by the system haven.
